title: American Inventors: Rocket Scientist Robert Goddard
titleZh: 美国发明家：火箭科学家罗伯特·戈达德
credits: Shirley Griffith reported on this story for VOA Learning English. Bryan Lynn adapted it.

sentences.en: Today rocket launches and space missions are common.
sentences.zh: 如今，火箭发射和太空任务已司空见惯。

sentences.en: But in the early 1900s, space travel seemed like a dream.
sentences.zh: 然而在20世纪初，太空旅行似乎只是一个梦想。

sentences.en: One of the most influential people in the field of rocket science was American Robert Goddard.
sentences.zh: 在火箭科学领域，最具影响力的人物之一是美国人罗伯特·戈达德。

sentences.en: The American space agency NASA describes Goddard as “the father of modern rocket propulsion.”
sentences.zh: 美国航天局NASA将戈达德誉为"现代火箭推进之父"。

sentences.en: Robert Goddard once said that "the dream of yesterday is the hope of today and the reality of tomorrow."
sentences.zh: 罗伯特·戈达德曾说过："昨日的梦想，是今天的希望，也是明天的现实。"

sentences.en: His scientific work gave hope to many dreams about space travel.
sentences.zh: 他的科学研究为许多关于太空梦想的憧憬带来了希望。

sentences.en: He turned some of those dreams into reality.
sentences.zh: 他把其中一些梦想变成了现实。

sentences.en: More than one hundred years ago, Goddard carried out studies and tests of rocket engines.
sentences.zh: 一百多年前，戈达德进行了火箭发动机的研究和测试。

sentences.en: He developed and flew many rockets that got their power from solid fuels: chemicals that formed a hard substance.
sentences.zh: 他研发并发射了许多由固体燃料提供动力的火箭：那些能形成坚硬物质的化学物质。

sentences.en: In 1925, he made and tested the first rocket engine using a soft chemical fuel.
sentences.zh: 1925年，他制造并测试了第一台使用液体化学燃料的火箭发动机。

sentences.en: The next year, he successfully launched the world's first liquid-fuel rocket.
sentences.zh: 次年，他成功发射了世界第一枚液体燃料火箭。

sentences.en: Many historians consider liquid-fuel rocket flight to be as important as the first airplane flight by the American brothers Orville and Wilbur Wright.
sentences.zh: 许多历史学家认为，液体燃料火箭的飞行与美国兄弟威尔伯和奥维尔·莱特首次驾驶飞机飞行具有同等重要的意义。

sentences.en: Goddard's work proved that machines could travel outside of Earth's atmosphere and into space.
sentences.zh: 戈达德的工作证明了机器能够飞出地球大气层进入太空。

sentences.en: During his early research, he received money and support from the U.S. Smithsonian Institution.
sentences.zh: 在早期研究期间，他获得了美国史密森尼学会的资金和支持。

sentences.en: The Smithsonian published several reports about his efforts.
sentences.zh: 史密森尼学会发表了几份关于他努力的报告。

sentences.en: One publication, called “A Method of Reaching Extreme Altitudes,” wrote about his search for ways to send weather recording instruments higher than balloons could fly.
sentences.zh: 其中一份名为《达到极高海拔的方法》的出版物，记述了他探索将气象记录仪器送上气球无法到达的高空的方法。

sentences.en: It described how he developed the mathematical theories for rocket flight.
sentences.zh: 它描述了他如何为火箭飞行建立数学理论。

sentences.en: In that report, Goddard also suggested the possibility of a rocket someday reaching the moon.
sentences.zh: 在那份报告中，戈达德还提出了火箭有朝一日抵达月球的可能性。

sentences.en: At the time, there was a big dispute in the press about this claim.
sentences.zh: 当时，媒体就这一说法展开了激烈争论。

sentences.en: Many people thought he was foolish for suggesting something that seemed so impossible.
sentences.zh: 许多人认为他提出这样看似不可能的事情是愚蠢的。

sentences.en: Many of Goddard’s ideas are still used in rocket development.
sentences.zh: 戈达德的许多想法至今仍被用于火箭研发。

sentences.en: So, in a way, every rocket that flies today could be considered a Goddard rocket.
sentences.zh: 所以，从某种意义上说，今天每一枚升空的火箭都可以被称为戈达德火箭。

sentences.en: I’m Bryan Lynn.
sentences.zh: 我是布莱恩·林恩。

glossary.def: a flight into space aimed at reaching a goal
a force that pushes something forward
